messages:
Lindsey: Quick announcement — we’re making a FIPS-certified crypto module available for Private deployments and publishing a new Emergency Key Rotation policy. Customers can opt into the FIPS KMS integration; mandatory rotation for legacy keys will start May 12. Docs + runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-fips-kms
Mike: Nice. What’s the customer impact here? Any downtime or data migration steps?
Lindsey: No app downtime expected. Two main actions: enable the fips_kms flag on the tenant, and either opt into auto-rotation or schedule a manual rotation window. We’ve included a one-click migration path in the runbook.
Zara: Security note: FIPS module only impacts encryption-at-rest keys (KMS). It doesn't change token handling in the control plane. We ran the compliance tests yesterday; passing certs are attached in the runbook.
Mike: Can you paste the CLI snippet for ops to enable this on a dev tenant?
Lindsey: Sure — example below:
```
# enable FIPS-backed KMS and auto rotation on tenant "acme-corp"
redwoodctl private update --tenant acme-corp --enable-fips-kms true --rotation-policy auto
```
Lindsey: After that, the tenant will show a new key status in Console -> Security -> Keys; rotation logs land in the audit bundle.
Ops Oncall: We'll schedule canaries tonight 22:00 UTC; full rollout windows listed in runbook. @platform-team please ACK if you need a different window.
Legal: Heads-up — we need to send a customer notification for the mandatory rotation 7 days before the May 12 enforcement. Draft notice is here: https://redwood.internal/notice-drafts/fips-rotation. Please review by EOD.
deploy-bot: staged-rollout started for private-fips-kms v1.0 -> canary group (10 tenants). Status: in-progress.
Mike: Thanks — will validate telemetry and make sure alerts are in place for rotation failures.
Zara: +1 on alerts. We added a high-severity PagerDuty rule if rotation fails more than 3 attempts.
Lindsey: Action items: 1) Platform: confirm canary window (Ops Oncall). 2) Legal: approve notice. 3) SEs: flag customers requiring extra support, cc @sales. 4) Eng: monitor the canary metrics (latency, key ops errors).
Lindsey: TL;DR: feature is available today, mandatory rotation enforcement on May 12, minimal customer impact if they opt into auto-rotation. Please read the runbook and ping here with blockers. :rocket:
